verdicts.reasoning: Every stem in Set B is an explicit two-way comparison of money sets: seed 57 asks which of ₱750 and ₱120 worth of pieces is greater, seed 11 asks which of ₱170 and ₱522 is smaller, so both directions of comparison are exercised.
verdicts.content_note_from_attester: Seed 11 asks which has the SMALLER value but offers '1 ₱20 bill and 2 ₱10 coins' (₱40) as an option; that is smaller than the keyed ₱170 set, so the distractor is also a true answer to the question as worded. Distractors that are neither of the two compared sets recur at seeds 57, 118 and 127.

verdicts.reasoning: The decision turns on totalled peso value rather than on how many pieces are shown: seed 103 keys the two-piece ₱700 set over the five-piece ₱655 set, and seed 42 weighs ₱805 against ₱270.
verdicts.content_note_from_attester: Seed 23 keys the bare letter 'A' while every other sample in this set keys the option's full text — inconsistent key representation within one set.

verdicts.reasoning: The two sides compared are built from unlike denominations rather than more or fewer of the same piece: seed 118 sets ₱500/₱100/₱50/₱10/₱1 against ₱10/₱5, and seed 127 sets a ₱100 plus a ₱20 against a ₱50 plus three ₱20s.
Eight distinct denominations are named as labelled pieces across the set — ₱1, ₱5, ₱10, ₱20, ₱50, ₱100, ₱200, ₱500 — with seed 64 using ₱500/₱200/₱20 and seed 11 using ₱100/₱50/₱20/₱1.

Coins appear as coins and carry weight in the comparison: three ₱1 coins are what separates ₱503 from ₱501 at seed 23, seed 42 includes a ₱5 coin, and seed 118's smaller side is a ₱10 coin and a ₱5 coin.
verdicts.content_note_from_attester: On seeds 23, 91 and 103 the PesoMoney visual draws only one of the two sets being compared, so the picture supports half the question; seeds 91 and 103 also carry is_interactive: true on what is a multiple-choice comparison.

verdicts.content_note_from_attester: Seed 23's stem names '1 ₱500 bill and 3 ₱1 coins' but its visual payload draws one ₱100 bill and two ₱200 bills (plus the three ₱1 coins). The total agrees at ₱503, but the pupil is shown bills that are not the ones the stem describes; bill_faces omits 500.
